item.title: Installing and Configuring Zsh on CentOS 7
item.description: 1. Install zsh 1 sudo yum install -y zsh 2. Install oh-my-zsh 1 sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)" It is recommended to set Zsh as the default shell. 3. Install Plugins 3.1 Install autojump 1 sudo yum install -y epel-release 1 sudo yum install -y autojump-zsh 3.2 Install zsh-autosuggestions 1 git clone git://github.
